item.text: The single archive path checks permission before rejecting already archived issues. For bulk, I’ll preserve the same permission rule while treating archived and nonmatching IDs as skipped, and complete all permission checks before writing any rows or emitting events.
The implementation is in place. I’m checking for a subtle requirement conflict in the shared permission helper and whether the archive loop preserves all-or-nothing behavior for permission failures.
